title: Exact Volume-Preserving Diffeomorphic Shear Splitting: Continuous-Discrete Geometric Bounds, Reversible Memory Backpropagation, and Expressivity Frontiers in Volumetric Mapping
abstract: arXiv:2611.31343v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Incompressible diffeomorphic registration requires continuous spatial mappings that preserve local tissue volume (det(D\Phi) = 1) without topological folding (det(D\Phi) > 0). Standard velocity-field methods (SVF, LDDMM) approximate incompressibility via numerical ODE integration or soft penalties, exhibiting numerical volume drift (~10^-4 to 10^-1), iterative grid inversions, and linear backpropagation memory O(L * N_vox).   We formulate an exact structure-preserving framework for 3D registration based on cascaded coordinate shears. By decomposing the divergence-free Lie algebra sdiff(\Omega) into six coordinate-shear generators whose convective non-linearities vanish identically, each elementary stage integrates analytically to a closed-form triangular shear with det(DS_k) = 1 and exact machine-precision inverse requiring zero iterations and zero spatial interpolations. translated_title: 精确保体积微分同胚剪切分裂：连续-离散几何界、可逆内存反向传播与体积映射中的表达能力前沿
translated_abstract: 不可压缩微分同胚配准需要保持局部组织体积（det(DΦ) = 1）且不发生拓扑折叠（det(DΦ) > 0）的连续空间映射。标准速度场方法（SVF、LDDMM）通过数值ODE积分或软惩罚来近似不可压缩性，存在数值体积漂移（约10^-4至10^-1）、迭代网格求逆以及O(L * N_vox)的线性反向传播内存开销等问题。
tldr: 该论文提出基于级联坐标剪切的精确保体积微分同胚配准框架，将无散度李代数分解为六个剪切生成元，实现闭合形式的精确体积保持、机器精度的零迭代求逆以及可逆的低内存反向传播。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an exact structure-preserving framework for 3D incompressible diffeomorphic registration based on cascaded coordinate shears, decomposing the divergence-free Lie algebra into six shear generators to achieve closed-form volume preservation, machine-precision zero-iteration inversion, and reversible memory-efficient backpropagation.
